Three large, multicentre controlled studies1-3 have shown that pregabalin in oral doses of between 300 and 600 mg daily is effective in reducing pain and other core symptoms of fibromyalgia (see Soft-tissue Rheumatism, p.13) such as sleep disturbance and fatigue. The drug was reported to be generally well tolerated, dizziness and somnolence being the most common adverse effects. Pain relief appears to be largely independent of reduction in anxiety or depression scores.4 1. Crofford LJ, et al. Pregabalin 1008-105 Study Group.
